verdict.rationale: AMD's docs describe ROCm as an open-source GPU computing stack (compilers, HIP runtime, libraries) that runs on Linux, and list the MI325X (gfx942) as a ROCm-supported target. That shows an open user-space stack for this GPU, but the pack never addresses the kernel-level driver itself. missing for 10: vendor documentation of open-source kernel modules or upstream Linux kernel driver support for MI325X, explicit driver-level licensing/source details, independent or hands-on corroboration of running on an open driver.
